# NLI derivation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:methodNliDerivation`](gmeow-methodNliDerivation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/methodNliDerivation>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The claim (typically a support/refute verdict) was derived by a natural-language-inference judgment over existing text.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationMethod.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:methodNliDerivation`](gmeow-methodNliDerivation.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationMethod.md).
